crossRefs.note: The mouth of the righteous talks of wisdom. His tongue speaks justice.
You are the most excellent of the sons of men. Grace has anointed your lips, therefore God has blessed you forever.
Then I will teach transgressors your ways. Sinners will be converted to you.
My mouth will tell about your righteousness, and of your salvation all day, though I don’t know its full measure.
I will open my mouth in a parable. I will utter dark sayings of old,
With my lips, I have declared all the ordinances of your mouth.
Further, because the Preacher was wise, he still taught the people knowledge. Yes, he pondered, sought out, and set in…
The Preacher sought to find out acceptable words, and that which was written blamelessly, words of truth.
Your lips, my bride, drip like the honeycomb. Honey and milk are under your tongue. The smell of your garments is like…
What I tell you in the darkness, speak in the light; and what you hear whispered in the ear, proclaim on the housetops.
Jesus came to them and spoke to them, saying, “All authority has been given to me in heaven and on earth.
He said to them, “Go into all the world, and preach the Good News to the whole creation.
The Lord said to Paul in the night by a vision, “Don’t be afraid, but speak and don’t be silent;
for I am with you, and no one will attack you to harm you, for I have many people in this city.”
How then will they call on him in whom they have not believed? How will they believe in him whom they have not heard?…
For I will not dare to speak of any things except those which Christ worked through me, for the obedience of the…
Let no corrupt speech proceed out of your mouth, but only what is good for building others up as the need may be, that…
The things which you have heard from me among many witnesses, commit the same things to faithful men, who will be able…
The tongue of the righteous is like choice silver. The heart of the wicked is of little worth.
The lips of the righteous feed many, but the foolish die for lack of understanding.
You offspring of vipers, how can you, being evil, speak good things? For out of the abundance of the heart, the mouth…
And the tongue is a fire. The world of iniquity among our members is the tongue, which defiles the whole body, and sets…

translations.web: The lips of the wise spread knowledge; not so with the heart of fools.
translations.bsb: The lips of the wise spread knowledge, but not so the hearts of fools.
translations.kjv: The lips of the wise disperse knowledge: but the heart of the foolish
translations.asv: The lips of the wise disperse knowledge; But the heart of the foolish doeth not so.
